addons.name: Language Server Protocol
addons.description: LSP client (lite-xl-lsp d1432ae) with our changes: squiggly diagnostics, diagnostics in hover popups, mouse_hover_mode.

addons.name: Lint+
addons.description: Linting plugin (lintplus 1aa6d2d) with squiggly underlines.
Build plugin (lite-xl-ide 50c1b40) with a task backend; toolbar font scales with SCALE.
Debugger (lite-xl-ide 50c1b40) with a breakpoint column and glyph markers.
Evaluate Lua in a running lite-xl; used by scripts/lxeval.
Syntax for YAML, with block scalars, YAML 1.2 booleans and null, one-character keys.
Switch tabs from a list; show_list option to switch without it.
Minimap, following our scrollbar's paging on track clicks.
Tab bar buttons for when tabs scroll: scroll left/right, and a menu of all tabs.
A menu bar of commands, shown when Alt is tapped, or dropped from a button.
A header bar in place of the title bar: menu button, file browser toggle, back/forward, and with config.borderless the title and window controls.
Marks the other occurrences of the selected text (whole words when a word is selected).
Search and replace interface using Widgets (lite-xl-plugins 6e4aa64).
Preview tabs (lite-xl-plugins 6e4aa64), marked by an italic name instead of ~ around it, not restored with the workspace; restored tabs stay regular.

Back and forward between document positions (lite-xl-plugins 6e4aa64), rewritten: records jumps (doc changes, moves over jump_threshold lines) on cursor change instead of polling, keeps history across closed files, alt+shift+left/right within the current doc.

File icons for TreeView and tabs from Nerd Font symbols (lite-xl-plugins 6e4aa64); tab icons no longer cover truncated titles; icon colors adjusted for contrast; a terminal icon for terminal tabs; icon badges in tabs.
Integrated terminal (lite-xl-terminal e1cd371); libterminal is built by lite-xl's meson build.
Spell checking with hunspell, toggled per document; identifiers are checked by their camelCase/snake_case parts. The hunspell module is built by lite-xl's meson build.
Ctrl+click opens URLs, DOIs and [[wiki links]] to local files; links can be underlined; Search Web for the selection in the context menu.
In a git repository, the project's files are those git doesn't ignore; untracked files marked in the treeview; Show All Files in its context menu.
Widget toolkit (lite-xl-widgets) that doesn't queue redraws when showing a visible widget.
Antialiased shape helpers (squiggle) using renderer.draw_path.
Light theme matching Qt Creator's.
